title: Several different clients continue to display errors and information even when they are not being used
body: ### Tested versions v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439] ### System information linux ### Issue description I’m not entirely sure whether there is already an open issue about this. I do know for certain that this error exists in many versions of Godot 4 and hasn’t been fixed. I don’t know why it hasn’t been fixed, because this is a very bad error for anyone testing a networked game. In general, you continue to see old clients, their errors, and logs, even though the actual number of instances may no longer be the same. ### Steps to reproduce Just create 3 clients, then get an error on the third client, for example, and later you want to use only 2 or 1 client, but now you will always be "punished" by the logs from the third window. This is bad because there are projects where you need to test multiple times with a different number of clients simultaneously, and this error will confuse you. Temporary workaround: 1. Restart Godot 2. Each time you open such clients, manually clear the log (though the tab will remain) Solution: Remove the tab when changing the number of clients in the settings. It’s very simple, and all the mechanisms are already there to write these few lines. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Follow the behavior described above—you can reproduce this in any project.
